metadata.description: Marketplace for Agile Agents — the Agentic Agile Harness.

plugins.name: agile-agents-core
plugins.description: Agentic Agile Harness for GitHub Copilot CLI — an RPI (Research, Plan, Implement, Review) pipeline of 11 specialist agents and a shared skill library. Language, IaC, and tracker specifics ship as companion plugins.

plugins.name: agile-agents-dotnet
plugins.description: .NET / C# implementation and testing skills for the Agentic Agile Harness — modern C#, xUnit/NUnit/MSTest/TUnit, EF Core, Aspire, and design-pattern review.

plugins.name: agile-agents-python
plugins.description: Python implementation and testing skills for the Agentic Agile Harness — type-hinted src layout, pytest, coverage, and Ruff.

plugins.name: agile-agents-bicep
plugins.description: Bicep Infrastructure-as-Code skills for the Agentic Agile Harness — Azure Verified Modules, AVM version updates, and Well-Architected alignment.

plugins.name: agile-agents-terraform
plugins.description: Terraform Infrastructure-as-Code skills for the Agentic Agile Harness — azurerm/AzAPI providers, Azure Verified Modules, plan-diff analysis, and resource import.

plugins.name: agile-agents-azure
plugins.description: Azure platform grounding for the Agentic Agile Harness — CAF naming and tagging, Azure Verified Modules, secure-by-default resource settings, the Well-Architected pillars as review checks, and MCSB / CIS Azure control ids. Pairs with microsoft/azure-skills for live-subscription work.

plugins.name: agile-agents-ado
plugins.description: Azure DevOps Boards tracker mechanics for the Agentic Agile Harness — work-item CRUD, WIQL queries, field and state conventions, and parent/child linking used by the backlog-manager agent.

plugins.name: agile-agents-github
plugins.description: GitHub Issues tracker mechanics for the Agentic Agile Harness — issue CRUD, sub-issue hierarchy, labels, and project fields used by the backlog-manager agent.
